desired_performances: Given a tabular dataset, transform missing or invalid values and justify the transformation choices.

objectives.performance: Identify missing and invalid values in a tabular dataset using pandas
success_criteria: Correctly identifies all missing values (NaN, None, empty strings)
Distinguishes between missing and invalid values

assumption_notes: Assumes pandas is the primary library for tabular data in Python
Assumes learner will work with standard formats like CSV

objectives.performance: Apply appropriate transformation strategies for missing values based on data characteristics
conditions: Given a dataset with missing values

assumption_notes: Assumes basic statistical understanding is prerequisite
Assumes focus on common strategies rather than advanced ML-based imputation

objectives.performance: Justify transformation choices by evaluating trade-offs and data context
conditions: Given a specific dataset and business context
success_criteria: Identifies potential biases or limitations introduced
Compares alternative approaches and their trade-offs

assumption_notes: Assumes learners need to develop professional judgment about data decisions

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can transform missing or invalid values in a tabular dataset and justify the transformation choices

required_evidence.criterion: Correctly identifies all missing and invalid values in the provided dataset
Applies at least two different transformation strategies appropriately based on column characteristics
Provides written justification for each transformation decision that addresses trade-offs

task.description: Given a real-world tabular dataset with multiple types of missing and invalid values, write a Python script that cleans the data and produces a written report justifying each transformation decision
conditions: Dataset contains numeric and categorical columns

performance_levels: Identifies most missing values but misses invalid patterns
Comprehensively identifies all missing and invalid values with correct categorization
Applies single strategy to all columns
Applies different strategies but some are inappropriate for data type
Applies contextually appropriate strategies for each column type and pattern
Articulates trade-offs, potential biases, and alternative approaches considered

scoring.mastery_rule: All dimensions must be at highest performance level

assumption_notes: Assumes 45 minutes is sufficient for focused performance task within 60-minute constraint
Assumes written justification is appropriate evidence of evaluative thinking

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can identify missing and invalid values using pandas

required_evidence.criterion: Correctly applies .isnull() or .isna() to detect missing values

task.description: Write code to identify and count missing values in each column of a provided DataFrame

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can select and apply appropriate transformation strategy

required_evidence.criterion: Chooses different strategies for numeric vs categorical data

task.description: Given descriptions of three columns with missing data, select the most appropriate transformation strategy for each and implement it

prerequisites.capability: Write and execute basic Python code including variables, functions, and control flow
Load and inspect DataFrames using pandas basics
prerequisites.rationale: Required to work with tabular data in Python, but not explicitly confirmed in learner state

prerequisites.capability: Understand basic descriptive statistics (mean, median, mode, distribution)
prerequisites.rationale: Necessary to make informed decisions about imputation strategies

prerequisites.capability: Familiarity with common data quality issues in real-world datasets
prerequisites.rationale: Helpful context but can be introduced during instruction

sequencing_rationale: Module 1 builds foundation by teaching identification before transformation
Module 2 provides procedural skills to apply transformations after learners can identify issues
Module 3 develops evaluative judgment after learners have practical experience with strategies
Summative assessment (10 minutes reserved) integrates all three objectives

assumption_notes: 50 minutes instruction + 10 minutes for summative assessment to meet 60-minute constraint

lessons.lesson_goal: Learner can use pandas methods to detect missing values in a DataFrame
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Follow along with live coding demonstration showing .isnull(), .isna(), .info(), and .describe() methods on sample dataset

assumption_notes: Demonstration pattern chosen to efficiently introduce pandas methods

lessons.lesson_goal: Learner can distinguish missing values from invalid values and categorize data quality issues
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Work through scaffolded exercise identifying different types of issues (NaN, None, empty strings, out-of-range values, format errors) in provided dataset

lessons.lesson_goal: Learner understands the spectrum of transformation strategies and when each is appropriate
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Review presented decision framework covering deletion (listwise/pairwise), imputation (mean/median/mode/forward-fill), and flagging strategies with context for each

assumption_notes: Explanation pattern provides conceptual foundation before practice

lessons.lesson_goal: Learner can implement appropriate transformation strategies for different column types
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Study worked example showing complete transformation pipeline for dataset with numeric and categorical columns, then apply similar approach to new dataset

assumption_notes: Worked example pattern supports transfer of procedural knowledge

lessons.lesson_goal: Learner can articulate trade-offs and justify data transformation decisions
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Analyze scenario where different transformation choices lead to different conclusions, discuss potential biases introduced, and write justification for recommended approach

assumption_notes: Scenario pattern develops evaluative judgment through authentic decision-making context

lessons.lesson_goal: Teach pandas DataFrame basics for learners without prior pandas experience
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Learn to load CSV, view DataFrame structure, and access columns

assumption_notes: Optional remedial lesson for learners missing prereq-02
Time not included in main 60-minute estimate

special_review_question: Ignoring machine traceability or schema issues, is this instructional design pedagogically reasonable?
